verdict.rationale: Relay's docs show some ways to get transaction data out: automatic syncing of detailed transaction data to QuickBooks Online and Xero, and Plaid connections to other money apps. These are integrations with third-party tools rather than a documented full-data export in open formats such as CSV or OFX. Missing for 10: documented bulk export of all account data, open-format files (CSV/OFX/JSON), statement and document download, account-closure and offboarding guidance, independent corroboration.
